import re
def norm_title(t): return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t.strip().lower())
src = {}

        src[(art["reviewer"], f["file"], str(f["line"]), norm_title(f["title"]))] = f

def hydrate(f):
    why, ev = None, []
    for r in f["reviewers"]:
        s = src.get((r, f["file"], str(f["line"]), norm_title(f["title"])))
        if s:
            if s.get("why_it_matters") and (why is None or len(s["why_it_matters"]) > len(why)):
                why = s["why_it_matters"]
            for e in s.get("evidence", []):
                if e not in ev: ev.append(e)
    out = dict(f)
    out["why_it_matters"] = why
    out["evidence"] = ev
    assert why and ev, f"hydration failed for #{f['#']}"
    return out
